_what:
scan_cap_path_slots.py -- PT-CAP9-U4a: the path-slot site census, every site classified.

WHY. U4 raises the per-player path pool 100 -> 500 slots (design: tmp/capraise/u4/REPORT.md, user decisions
2026-10-21). The pool is three arrays plus a byte in the unit record, and every access to them is an
instruction the patcher must either MOVE, SWITCH on the raise, or consciously leave alone:

  path_slot_id   unit record +0xaa (a byte; 0xff = no path), read by 54 MOVZX, checked by 17 CMP ,0xff, written by 4
  buffer         0xaee8c0  byte {heading,run}[8 players][100 slots][300 waypoints]; player stride 0xea60, slot 0x258
  flags          0xb74bb0  byte[8][100], player stride IMUL 0x64
  free count     0xb63bc0  int[8]
  data pointers  0x5d0ac0 -> flags, 0x5d0ac4 -> buffer (tactical row 0)
  hole           unit record +0xda..+0xdb, the 16-bit id's new home: NO instruction may touch it

Each site gets one POLICY (a column, derived from the class by `policy_of`, so a hand-edited verdict goes red):

  always_on        relocation: base / stride / size / data-pointer value. Applied whether or not the raise is ON.
  raise_switched   only behind the raise: the 6 scanner bounds, the free-count start value, the id reads (MOVZX
                   byte -> word at the new +0xda) and the id writes. Raise OFF never writes the hole.
  unchanged        stays as shipped: map_SavePlanetToDisk / map_LoadPlanetFromDisk keep the STOCK addresses as the
                   canonical mirror (the PT-CAP8 pattern), the CMP byte,0xff checks (the byte stays 0xff = no
                   path), the free-count INC/DEC/save/load, the two row-0 tactical loops, the pointer reads.

This tool applies NOTHING. U4b reads the table. The scanner takes an IMAGE PATH, so the same code answers
"does any stock pool site survive in this (patched) image": `--residual --exe PATCHED` (the U4b gate; the
clean exe lists every always_on site, a correctly patched image lists none).

DATA. tools/data/cap_path_slot_census.json. `--check` validates every invariant hermetically, re-derives the
whole table from the clean EN exe (md5 b3b389e8...) when it is on this machine (otherwise says so), and runs the
hook-overlap check (no mh.dll hook may overlap a U4 site). `--selftest` plants mutations that must go red.

usage:
  python tools/scan_cap_path_slots.py --check [--exe PATH]
  python tools/scan_cap_path_slots.py --selftest
  python tools/scan_cap_path_slots.py --gen [--exe PATH]
  python tools/scan_cap_path_slots.py --residual --exe IMAGE
  python tools/scan_cap_path_slots.py --report

hole.probe_note: unrestricted probe: every non-stack [reg+d] covering +0xda/+0xdb in ANY function. These are in functions that never address the units array or the id byte (other structs); the contract check above is restricted to unit-touching functions plus the direct form [units+0xda].

data_not_pointers.0x5074d4: inside a table of 16-bit pairs (0x14e0130 0x16d 0x3c001f 0x79005b [0xb60098] 0xf400d5 ...) between the strtok/strtod ctype tables; no instruction addresses it
data_not_pointers.0x5110a4: id-byte record table (0xb103 [0xb20400] 0xb3040000 0x4000000 0xb4 0xb504 ...): 0xb2 0xb3 0xb4 are the incrementing id of unaligned records, the same table as the units census' 0x511180; no references
data_not_pointers.0x5110b8: same incrementing-id record table as 0x5110a4 ([0xb60400] 0xb7040000 0x4000000 0xb8 0xb904); no references
data_not_pointers.0x66bdec: x86 code bytes embedded in DGROUP (8b 1d fc .. 47 37 83 ... a copy of a code fragment, with 0xb64bb0 beside it); an UNALIGNED 0x00b3820f, not a pointer; no instruction addresses it

evidence: slot = exit_air's 4th register param (ECX), spilled `MOV [EBP-0x20],ECX` (dword, 0x48b03b) and pushed `PUSH dword [EBP-0x20]` (0x48b0e0/0x48b0e3); the callee reads it as the dword [EBP+8]
callee uses it as IMUL [EBP+8],0x258 (slot offset in the buffer, 0x495ea1/0x495ecf) and `MOV EBX,[EBP+8]` for attach_slot (0x495ee6, a dword in EBX)
the value originates in exit_storage_begin: `CALL find_free_slot; MOV [EBP-0x1c],EAX; CMP [EBP-0x1c],-1` (0x47f04b..0x47f053), a signed dword
0x48b0f3.u4_impact: none: no byte/word truncation anywhere on the path; a slot > 255 flows through unchanged. The callee's own buffer writes (0x495eb7, 0x495edf) and attach call are already census rows.

evidence: slot = accept_landing's 4th register param (ECX), spilled `MOV [EBP-0x10],ECX` (dword, 0x48ba38), passed in EBX (`MOV EBX,[EBP-0x10]`, 0x48ba3e) and stored `MOV [EBP-0x20],EBX` in the callee (0x495b8a)
callee hands it on as `MOV EBX,[EBP-0x20]; CALL attach_slot` (0x495ca0/0x495caa) and indexes the buffer with the stack walk, never with the slot value
the value originates in landing_request: `CALL find_free_slot; MOV [EBP-0x18],EAX; CMP [EBP-0x18],-1` (0x4801a2..0x4801aa), a signed dword

hook_ok.0x41ec1d: SITE_ATK_HEADING: MOV AL,[EBP-0x20] (3 bytes 0x41ec1d-0x41ec1f) ends where the buf_base site 0x41ec20 begins; the hook flips ONE operand byte at 0x41ec1f, no detour
hook_ok.0x41ec1f: the operand byte of that same MOV AL,[EBP-0x20] (E0 -> E4); one byte, inside the MOV

notes: design floors vs measured: see counts; ids are counted per instruction (an instruction has one id operand).

tact_bound rows: llm_tact_move_step_attempt (the tactical scanner, slots 1..99) and llm_tact_map_reset (its reset) walk row 0 only; they are not in the design's list of six scanners. Policy unchanged (tactical never exceeds 100 slots); U4c decides whether a strategic->tactical->strategic round trip needs them to clear slots 100..500.
flag_clear_bound (map_FillDefaults 0x45623c) is always_on: with the flags stride 501 the clear must cover the whole row; clearing flags that raise OFF never sets is a no-op.
